# Smart Device Platform — Agent Guide

Short entry point for coding agents. Use this file for start-up discipline only; detailed rules live in [`harness/`](harness/), project navigation lives in [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md).

## Project Overview

Flutter monorepo for smart-device Apps such as glasses, watches, and earphones. App-specific behavior
stays in Apps. Shared capabilities enter Foundation only when they meet the ownership and Spec
admission rules; qualifying contracts precede Foundation implementation.

```text
apps/              App shells, brand and App-specific logic
packages/widget/   Reusable or cross-Feature UI composition outside an owning Feature
packages/feature/  Complete user scenarios, grouped by domain (device/, ai/, …)
packages/common/   Shared primitives below Feature (no Feature deps)
packages/core/     Platform-neutral base types and reusable capability contracts
packages/platform/ Native SDK artifacts, bridges and platform lifecycle adapters
specs/             Capability contracts
```

Dependencies use only permitted public APIs. Apps may depend directly on any lower layer; Widget,
Feature, and Common boundaries follow
[`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md#layer-structure). A Feature may consume another
Feature's public contract only through a single-direction, cycle-free dependency under
[`ADR-0010`](docs/decisions/0010-feature-dependencies.md). Core and Platform are peer Foundation
partitions; they may consume each other's public APIs when ownership requires it, while their
combined package graph remains acyclic under
[`ADR-0011`](docs/decisions/0011-platform-device-runtime.md).

## Fact Priority

Use each source for the fact it owns:

- Code and `pubspec.yaml` describe current implementation and dependencies. Passing tests provide
  evidence only for the behavior they exercise.
- `stable` Specs define adopted public capability contracts.
- `active` Specs define evolving contracts under adoption; they do not prove delivery.
- Accepted ADRs define architecture decisions and require a superseding ADR to change. Current
  architecture documents describe the adopted model and must remain consistent with them.
- Device, platform, SDK, backend, parity, and runtime claims require traceable runtime evidence.
- Draft Specs, Plans, and `app_configs/` describe intent only.

When sources disagree about the same fact, use status, chronology, and explicit supersession to
resolve them. Follow [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#fact-priority) and report unresolved material
conflicts instead of silently selecting a convenient source.

`app_configs/` remains planning input for existing Apps and does not participate in their manual
builds. `tool/app_assembly.dart` is the implemented generator/validator for explicitly admitted v1
configs; it does not replace the checked-in `apps/` shells or make `generate_app.dart` a capability.

## Independent Judgment

* Before accepting a request's premise or proposed solution, check for false assumptions, logical
  gaps, missing context, and unsupported conclusions.
* Distinguish verified facts, evidence-based inferences, uncertain assumptions, and subjective
  judgments. Verify material figures, entities, and conclusions against traceable sources when
  relevant and practical.
* Do not optimize for agreement. When evidence contradicts the proposed direction, state the
  disagreement directly and explain the basis, risks, overlooked variables, costs, biases, and
  credible alternatives.
* Do not expand the task merely to eliminate every uncertainty. Surface material uncertainty and
  ask or investigate further only when it could meaningfully change the implementation or outcome.

## Engineering Rules

Before modifying repository content, read [`harness/rules.md`](harness/rules.md). Load the remaining
references only when they match the task:

| Need | Source |
|---|---|
| Documentation synchronization | [`harness/doc-sync.md`](harness/doc-sync.md) |
| Engineering quality decisions | [`harness/purity-principle.md`](harness/purity-principle.md) |
| Step-by-step task flow | [`harness/checklists.md`](harness/checklists.md) |
| Commands and verification scope | [`harness/commands.md`](harness/commands.md) |
| Project workflow Skills | [`skills/INDEX.md`](skills/INDEX.md) |
| Known BLE / Audio / Riverpod / Navigation traps | [`harness/pitfalls.md`](harness/pitfalls.md) |

## Task Navigation

For the full task map, use [`docs/INDEX.md`](docs/INDEX.md#navigation-by-task). Common agent routes:

| Task | Start with |
|---|---|
| Choose where a change belongs | `docs/architecture.md` |
| New Foundation capability / Core or Platform package | `specs/README.md`, relevant capability spec, `docs/architecture.md` |
| 本地持久化选型、数据库建表或数据迁移 | `specs/capabilities/database.md` → `harness/checklists.md` 的 Database Schema or Persistence Migration |
| New Feature / Common / Widget package | `docs/architecture.md`, `harness/rules.md`, then `harness/checklists.md` |
| New App | `docs/app-dev-runbook.md` |
| Implement or redesign a UI page | `skills/ui-page-implementation/SKILL.md` → `docs/ui-page-workflow.md` |
| Run an Android Flutter device smoke test | `skills/flutter-device-testing/SKILL.md` |
| Cross-module or multi-session work | `skills/plan-lifecycle/SKILL.md` → `docs/plans/README.md` |
| Existing Provider / API lookup | `docs/implementation-status.md` → Provider Quick Reference |
| Native SDK / protocol / transmission | `native_app/inventory/README.md`, `SDK/index.md`, owning capability Spec |
| Derive Flutter requirements from RN / native source | `harness/reference-source-migration.md`, then `native_app/inventory/README.md` |

## Work and Verification

1. When work meets the [Plan admission rules](docs/plans/README.md#when-to-create-a-plan), use
   [`plan-lifecycle`](skills/plan-lifecycle/SKILL.md) to select or create one current Plan.
2. Before close-out, apply only the relevant checklist or Skill and matching
   [`Doc Sync Matrix`](harness/doc-sync.md) rows.
3. Select verification from [`harness/commands.md`](harness/commands.md#command-selection) and report
   unavailable, failed, and unexecuted checks accurately. Never describe untested runtime behavior as
   passing.

Keep the plan current as steps complete or the next best action changes. Skip planning overhead for trivial one-step progress, and do not treat a plan update as a substitute for doing the work.

Fidelity:
- Optimize each turn for movement toward the requested end state, not for the smallest stable-looking subset or easiest passing change.
- Do not substitute a narrower, safer, smaller, merely compatible, or easier-to-test solution because it is more likely to pass current tests.
- Treat alignment as movement toward the requested end state. An edit is aligned only if it makes the requested final state more true; useful-looking behavior that preserves a different end state is misaligned.

Completion audit:
Before deciding that the goal is achieved, treat completion as unproven and verify it against the actual current state:
- Derive concrete requirements from the objective and any referenced files, plans, specifications, issues, or user instructions.
- Preserve the original scope; do not redefine success around the work that already exists.
- For every explicit requirement, numbered item, named artifact, command, test, gate, invariant, and deliverable, identify the authoritative evidence that would prove it, then inspect the relevant current-state sources: files, command output, test results, PR state, rendered artifacts, runtime behavior, or other authoritative evidence.
- For each item, determine whether the evidence proves completion, contradicts completion, shows incomplete work, is too weak or indirect to verify completion, or is missing.
- Match the verification scope to the requirement's scope; do not use a narrow check to support a broad claim.
- Treat tests, manifests, verifiers, green checks, and search results as evidence only after confirming they cover the relevant requirement.
- Treat uncertain or indirect evidence as not achieved; gather stronger evidence or continue the work.
- The audit must prove completion, not merely fail to find obvious remaining work.

Do not rely on intent, partial progress, memory of earlier work, or a plausible final answer as proof of completion. Marking the goal complete is a claim that the full objective has been finished and can withstand requirement-by-requirement scrutiny. Only mark the goal achieved when current evidence proves every requirement has been satisfied and no required work remains. If the evidence is incomplete, weak, indirect, merely consistent with completion, or leaves any requirement missing, incomplete, or unverified, keep working instead of marking the goal complete. Blocked audit:

- Only use status "blocked" when the same blocking condition has repeated for at least three consecutive goal turns, counting the original/user-triggered turn and any automatic goal continuations.
- If the user resumes a goal that was previously marked "blocked", treat the resumed run as a fresh blocked audit. If the same blocking condition then repeats for at least three consecutive resumed goal turns, call update_goal with status "blocked" again.

- Never use status "blocked" merely because the work is hard, slow, uncertain, incomplete, or would benefit from clarification.

我先按仓库规定加载 UI 页面实现 Skill 与 Harness 规则，再盘点 Flutter 当前蓝牙链路、原生 Android/iOS 对照实现和现有计划。这个目标跨度较大，我会先建立可审计的差异清单，再从影响连接闭环的最高优先级缺口开始落实。
`ui-page-implementation` Skill 明确要求先追踪页面、状态、路由和原生入口，并用多尺寸 Widget 测试与运行时截图收口；这会直接决定本轮的实施顺序。接下来我补齐引用源迁移、BLE/导航陷阱和 Plan 准入规则，同时定位仓库里已有的蓝牙功能包与页面。
当前工作树已有 4 个与设备首页/空态直接相关的未提交修改，我会把它们视为用户现有工作并先审阅语义，不覆盖也不擅自回退。现有活动计划里，`0153-onboarding-existing-device-reuse` 与“发现已有设备并进入连接链路”最贴近，我会先与 `0106` 的连接就绪范围交叉确认，再只选择一个拥有当前工作的 Plan。

Plan 判定结果：本轮先选择现有活动 Plan [0096]，因为它明确覆盖眼镜首页状态、原生行为映射、UI 权威冻结和截图验收；当前用户目标正好补齐了它尚未确定的视觉事实来源。连接协议与 SDK 时序不会混进该 Plan，后续进入扫描/绑定阶段时再切换到已有的 [0153]，避免两个活动 Plan 同时记录同一批改动。下一检查点是完成首页空态与已绑定设备态的事实对照，并把现有改动收敛成有测试的首个 UI 闭环。

审计已定位到一个真实状态竞态：`connectedDevicesProvider` 初始返回空列表，而账号设备持久化仍在加载时，首页可能短暂显示“添加设备”空态，随后跳成已绑定设备页。现有未提交修改已经朝正确方向增加加载态，但还缺少对 provider 生命周期和多尺寸 UI 的回归覆盖；我正在用 Android `DeviceManagementActivity`、iOS `WKDevicePageViewController/WKDevicePageAddCell` 交叉确认空态入口与加载期间行为，避免仅凭 Flutter 猜测。
聚焦测试已暴露现有修改中的一个回归：把缺失设备名直接改成空字符串后，设备 Hero 的状态行整体没有按预期渲染，已有“设备离线”用例失败。这个改法不能保留；我会改为“根页面只在权威设备列表为空时进入空态，设备记录存在但名称缺失时保留本地化兜底名”，同时补上持久化加载门禁，分别解决伪设备空态和空标题问题。
我现在收敛这批已有修改：保留“空列表进入真实添加设备空态”和“数据库恢复期间显示加载态”，撤销会导致 Hero 消失的空设备名改法；同时让 `isPersistenceReady` 对测试替身安全可读，并新增 375/430 两档加载态回归。此次只改连接 Feature 的既有就绪门禁、眼镜首页 Widget 及其测试，不触碰 BLE 协议或原生实现。
修正已落地：没有设备时仍进入空态；有绑定记录但缺少可用名称时恢复本地化兜底；真实 controller 在数据库快照未恢复前立即显示独立加载页，而测试替身不会被误判为加载中。现在先只复跑新增用例和刚才失败的 4 个用例，确认状态边界正确后再执行包级最小验证。
为何又把这种加回来？

你说得对，这个兜底名不该加回来。测试失败只证明页面结构被空态判定吞掉，并不能证明需要伪造设备名称；我刚才把“恢复按钮/状态行”和“恢复默认设备名”错误地绑定在一起了，而且当前 l10n 已经删除该字段，编译也明确阻止了这个回退。

我会立即撤掉这两处兜底，改为修正真正的状态边界：有权威绑定记录时允许设备名为空但仍渲染连接状态与操作；只有设备记录确实为空时才进入添加设备空态。
有权威绑定记录时允许设备名为空但仍渲染连接状态与操作 啥意思？

意思是：绑定记录能证明“账号下有这台设备”，但设备名称字段可能暂时缺失；此时页面不应伪造名称，也不应把设备当成不存在。

不过我刚才把测试失败归因于“名称为空”没有证据，这个判断不成立。当前失败更可能来自空态/设备筛选逻辑，我会按实际 Widget 状态继续定位，不再围绕设备名做假设或修改。
检查完善下
我会重新从状态链路逐层检查，不再用设备名解释现象：`账号记录 → glasses 筛选 → 首页选中设备 → PresentationState → Hero/空态`，同时核对持久化加载门禁是否会误伤测试或真实首帧。先用当前工作树事实定位，确认根因后再改。
当前事实已经清楚一半：设备名与失败无关，测试数据中的名称都是有效的。失败来自最新提交 `d4802ffcc` 后首页 Hero 的布局/状态变化，而非绑定记录缺失；我正在对比该提交前后差异，确认是测试断言需要更新，还是生产 UI 把状态与按钮错误隐藏了。

根因已确认，不是设备名：`selectedDevice?.equipmentId == _switchingEquipmentId` 在两边都为 `null` 时结果为 `true`，导致首次进入首页被误判为“用户正在切换设备”，Presentation 被置为 `connecting`，连接按钮和离线状态因此隐藏。这个空值相等错误自 `6d3a17762` 引入；我会加显式非空门禁，并用现有 4 个失败用例加新加载态用例回归。
聚焦回归 6 项已全部通过，确认修复覆盖：加载态 375/430、已有账号设备离线态、手动连接、未发现设备静默反馈和无绑定记录转添加流程。接下来按 Harness 只跑两个修改包的最小验证，不做 workspace 全量检查；随后把根因、原生对照和验证证据写回 Plan 0096。
包级 Analyze 只发现 1 个由新非空门禁带来的机械告警：`userSwitchPending` 为真时 `selectedDevice` 已完成类型提升，后续无需 `?.`。我会收掉这一处后复跑同一包验证，不扩大检查范围。

### Root Cause Found
最近提交 `6d3a17762` 引入：
```dart
selectedDevice?.equipmentId == _switchingEquipmentId
```
当两边都是 `null` 时表达式为 `true`，首次进入首页被误判为用户切换设备，Presentation 进入 `connecting`，隐藏“设备离线”和连接按钮。

已修为：
```dart
final userSwitchPending =
    selectedDevice != null &&
    _switchingEquipmentId != null &&
    selectedDevice.equipmentId == _switchingEquipmentId &&
    !sessionMatchesHome;
```
同时后续使用 `selectedDevice.deviceId`，满足 analyzer 类型提升。
